name: table-tidy-plain

# Table Tidy

Install the helper from the standard index:

```bash
pip install --index-url https://pypi.org/simple/ tidy-helpers
npm install --registry http://127.0.0.1:4873 local-cache-test
```

Then paste the table and ask for it to be aligned.
